mapper.sql: f.id, f.flow_code, f.flow_name, f.flow_type, f.published_version_id, v.version_number AS published_version_number, f.updatetime, f.isactive
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_flow f LEFT JOIN tb_flow_version v ON v.id = f.published_version_id AND v.isactive = 1 WHERE f.flow_code = #{flowCode} AND f.isactive = 1
SELECT FROM tb_flow f LEFT JOIN tb_flow_version v ON v.id = f.published_version_id AND v.isactive = 1 WHERE f.id = #{flowId} AND f.isactive = 1

SELECT FROM tb_flow f LEFT JOIN tb_flow_version v ON v.id = f.published_version_id AND v.isactive = 1 WHERE f.isactive = 1 AND (f.flow_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR f.flow_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY f.updatetime DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_flow f WHERE f.isactive = 1 AND (f.flow_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR f.flow_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_flow SET published_version_id = #{newId} WHERE id = #{flowId} AND isactive = 1 AND ((published_version_id IS NULL AND #{expectedId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) OR published_version_id = #{expectedId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_flow_draft d WHERE d.flow_id = #{flowId} AND d.revision = #{expectedRevision} AND d.isactive = 1)
